Default Prove-Up Hearing.
Off Calendar Nov-16-2010 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for Default Prove-Up Hearing.
Dept. 218, Comm. Everett A. Hewlett, Jr., Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Scott Hughes, #12365.

Tony Ruch, Esq. appeared for plaintiff San Francisco Housing Authority.
No appearance by defendant Terry Windom.
Default was entered against defendant on October 12, 2010.
Order waiving witness appearance at default prove-up hearing was filed on October 26, 2010.

After hearing the evidence presented, and good cause appearing, the Court rules in favor of Plaintiff San Francisco Housing Authority, and against the Defaulted Defendant Terry Windom as follows:

Defendant Terry Windom is enjoined and restrained from commiting crimes, such as illegal drug use, possession and/or sales, and any other conduct amounting to a nuisance within the Potrero Terrace and Potrero Annex public housing developments, in accordance with Civil Code sections 3479, 3480 and 3491, and Code of Civil Procedure sections 526 & 731.

Judgment was submitted to and signed by the Court.
